cues: Three things happen: the reporting verb becomes ask; the question goes back to statement order; and do, does and did disappear.
Are you coming becomes he asked whether I was coming.
Do you like tea: he asked whether I liked tea.
Where did you go: he asked where I had gone.
What is your name: she asked what my name was.
A reported question has no question mark, and never put that before if or a wh word.
